subject.en: An amber-eyed ostrich in a brown hat with one bright feather cluster
subject.zh: 戴棕色宽檐帽的琥珀眼鸵鸟，帽上留一簇多彩羽毛

moment: The ostrich has just glanced back under its broad hat, a knowing, curious pause caught by a close portrait viewfinder.
interest: One attached coral, turquoise, blue, violet and golden feather cluster rises beside the hat and balances the bird’s glance.
paletteDirection: Warm tan, sandstone and cocoa across connected flat face, neck and hat facets; multicolor is concentrated in the one hat-feather cluster.

pattern.name: Windward feather relief
pattern.description: Long curved quills and spaced, gently splayed barbs enter the upper-left field and the lower-right paper edge. The paths form wind-swept feather rhythm without a closed leaf stencil.

background.status: Selected local ostrich presentation, separate from unchanged source website tokens.

tagline: A familiar glance beneath a feathered hat.

description.en: The original ostrich turns toward the left while its hat and feather spray balance the upper right. A close portrait keeps the face substantial; the natural neck continues through the bottom of the viewfinder. One uniform 90% placement gives the whole brim, beak and feather tips room inside the rounded tile.
description.zh: 沿用原来的鸵鸟，向左回眸，宽檐帽与羽毛在右上方平衡画面。近景保留饱满的面部，颈部自然延伸至取景框下沿；整体以 90% 等比放置，为帽檐、喙和羽尖留下圆角安全空间。

description.en: Connected sandstone, tan and cocoa planes carry the face, neck and brown hat. Amber eyes retain the familiar expression. Coral, turquoise, blue and violet gather in one attached feather cluster; the old satellite ornaments give way to this single accent.
description.zh: 砂岩、浅棕与可可色的连贯色块构成面部、颈部和棕帽，琥珀眼保留熟悉的神态。珊瑚、青蓝和紫色集中在帽上的一簇羽毛，原图分散的小装饰收拢为这一处兴趣点。

description.en: Warm linen paper carries long curved quills and spaced feather barbs through the empty corners. Soft light and shallow contact shadows give the presentation depth while the transparent bird remains free of background, grain and shadow.
description.zh: 暖亚麻纸面在留白处铺开弯曲的羽轴与疏朗羽纹，柔光和浅接触阴影增加层次。透明鸵鸟独立保存，不含底纹、背景或阴影。

sizeNote.en: The brim, beak and colorful feather silhouette carry the 32/16 px mark; individual eye facets and feather divisions soften at favicon size. Small app and browser marks use the transparent portrait, including its intentional lower neck entry.
sizeNote.zh: 32/16 px 主要依靠帽檐、喙与彩羽轮廓识别，眼部色块和羽毛分片在 favicon 尺寸会合并。小型应用和浏览器标记使用透明头像，并保留自然的下沿颈部入画。

subject.en: A worldly navy-and-ivory penguin holding binoculars
subject.zh: 手持望远镜、见多识广的深蓝与象牙白企鹅

moment: A well-travelled penguin has just lowered its binoculars and turns with a quietly observant expression.
interest: One compact binocular instrument projecting beside the upper body, with a restrained multicolored prism accent on the lens rims.
paletteDirection: Midnight navy and indigo feathers, opaque warm-ivory bib, restrained natural amber beak and feet; brass/coral/turquoise lens accents form one instrument group.

pattern.name: Far-horizon sightlines
pattern.description: Broad offset horizon bands open toward the penguin's gaze, with short restrained sighting ticks in the distant negative space.

background.status: Designed local presentation; separate from the existing source website palette.

tagline: A quiet observer with a wider view.

description.en: A compact whole penguin has lowered its binoculars and turns with calm curiosity. The navy body sits to the right while the instrument reaches into the left-hand space. Complete feet and feather tips stay comfortably inside the rounded viewfinder.
description.zh: 企鹅刚放下望远镜，带着平静的好奇回望。完整而紧凑的身体偏右，望远镜伸向左侧留白；脚趾与羽尖均在圆角取景框内保留充分空间。

description.en: Broad connected navy and indigo facets contrast with an opaque warm-ivory face and bib. The flippers support one brass-and-teal binocular instrument. Its lens facets form the sole multicolored accent group without covering the eyes.
description.zh: 连贯的深蓝与靛蓝色块衬托暖象牙白面部和腹部。双鳍自然托着黄铜与青色望远镜，镜片中的彩色碎片构成唯一一组多彩兴趣点，双眼保持清晰。

description.en: Mineral-blue paper opens into broad horizon arcs and short sighting ticks. The curves follow the penguin’s gaze and remain visible beside the dark body. Grain and contact shadows are independent of the transparent foreground.
description.zh: 矿物蓝纸面铺开宽阔的地平线弧与简短瞄准刻线，顺着企鹅的视线延伸，在深色主体旁保持可见。颗粒和接触阴影与透明前景分别保存。

sizeNote.en: The navy-and-ivory silhouette and lowered binoculars remain the main small-size cues. At 16 px the individual lens colors and eye facets merge. The 24 px sidebar and 16 px browser samples use the transparent penguin without its paper tile.
sizeNote.zh: 深蓝与象牙白轮廓、放下的望远镜是小尺寸下的主要识别点；16 px 时镜片彩色与眼部色块会合并。24 px 侧栏和 16 px 浏览器样例采用不带纸面底图的透明企鹅。

subject.en: A crafted shield behind a bow and arrow, sword and magic staff
subject.zh: 盾牌在后，弓箭、长剑与魔法杖在前的精制武器徽记

moment: A compact adventurer equipment emblem turns slightly toward the light, revealing the shield and three distinct class weapons.
interest: The complete weapon assembly is the identity; physical highlights and one violet gemstone provide hierarchy without an animal-style rainbow accessory.
paletteDirection: Deep forest enamel, antique gold and steel, warm timber and leather, one restrained violet gemstone.

pattern.name: Parchment heraldic lattice
pattern.description: Fine interlaced lozenges with short heraldic corner stitches give the parchment a crafted, game-specific relief without competing with the weapons.

background.status: Designed local presentation; separate from the existing source website palette.

tagline: An adventurer’s equipment, ready for the next chapter.

description.en: A timber shield anchors the back of the composition. A curved bow and arrow, steel sword and gemstone staff overlap in front as one compact equipment assembly. A gentle product-camera perspective preserves every weapon tip and the shield’s complete rim.
description.zh: 木盾稳住后景，弓箭、钢剑与宝石法杖在前方交叠，组成紧凑的冒险装备徽记。温和的产品摄影视角保留每一处武器尖端与完整盾缘。

description.en: Weathered timber, engraved antique gold, wrapped leather and polished steel give each object a distinct physical surface. One violet gemstone catches the light above the staff. This game emblem follows the physical-object series with continuous material shading.
description.zh: 旧木、雕刻古金、缠绕皮革与抛光钢材各有明确质感，法杖顶部的紫晶接住高光。这枚游戏徽记采用拟物系列的连续材质明暗。

description.en: Pale parchment carries a fine interlaced lozenge lattice and small heraldic corner stitches. A separate projected shadow lifts the shield and weapons gently from the page. Bright metal highlights remain in the foreground; the paper and shadow remain independent.
description.zh: 浅羊皮纸铺有精细交织菱格与小型纹章角饰，独立的投影让盾牌和武器轻轻浮起。金属高光保留在前景，纸面与阴影各自独立。

sizeNote.en: The shield and crossing weapon silhouettes carry the 32/16 px identity; engraved metal, the bowstring and timber grain resolve mainly in larger views. Browser and sidebar marks use the transparent equipment assembly. Large presentations use the parchment tile.
sizeNote.zh: 32/16 px 依靠盾牌与交叠武器的轮廓识别；金属雕花、弓弦与木纹主要在大图中呈现。浏览器和侧栏使用透明装备组合，大幅展示使用羊皮纸底图。

subject.en: A silver-blue American Shorthair head playing with one yarn loop
subject.zh: 拨弄一圈彩色毛线的银蓝美短猫头像

moment: A curious American Shorthair catches a small yarn loop with one real paw and tilts its face toward the viewer.
interest: One compact loop of multicolored yarn beside the cheek, touched by one natural paw; no second accessory.
paletteDirection: Fresh silver-blue and slate-gray classic tabby markings, ivory muzzle, warm amber eyes; coral, golden yellow, turquoise and violet only on the yarn loop.

pattern.name: Quiet yarn loops
pattern.description: One broad looping yarn path turns through the upper-right paper, with a separate short lower-left return and slim relief edges.

background.status: Designed local presentation; separate from the existing source website palette.

tagline: A curious little face, caught mid-play.

title.en: A tilted head and a waiting paw

description.en: The American Shorthair tilts its large head toward a single yarn strand held by one natural paw. Unequal ear heights and the loop beside the cheek establish the offset moment. The complete faceted shoulder contour is uniformly inset with generous room around ears, whiskers and yarn.
description.zh: 美短把大脑袋歪向一根毛线，一只自然的小爪轻轻按住它。高低错落的双耳与脸旁线圈形成偏心瞬间，完整的肩部色块轮廓等比内收，为耳尖、胡须和毛线留出空间。

description.en: Silver, slate blue and warm ivory form the classic tabby markings through connected flat facets. Amber eyes keep the expression clear. Coral, gold, turquoise and violet stay together along one continuous yarn strand instead of spreading across the coat.
description.zh: 银灰、石板蓝和暖象牙白以连贯的平面碎片构成经典虎斑，琥珀眼保持神态清楚。珊瑚、金、青与紫集中在一根连续毛线上，不散落到毛色中。

description.en: Muted mauve paper carries broad looping relief in the empty corners, echoing the yarn’s action at lower contrast. Fine grain, broad light and shallow contact shadows add depth while keeping the silver portrait distinct from the background.
description.zh: 柔和灰紫纸面在角落留白处铺开宽阔回环，以较低对比呼应毛线动作。细颗粒、宽柔光和浅接触阴影增加层次，让银灰头像与背景清楚分开。

sizeNote.en: At 32/16 px the tilted ears, silver tabby mask and amber eyes carry recognition. Fine whiskers and the two bends of the single yarn strand simplify. Sidebar and favicon marks use the transparent cat; large views may use the mauve presentation.
sizeNote.zh: 32/16 px 主要通过歪斜的双耳、银灰虎斑脸与琥珀眼识别；细胡须和同一根毛线的两个弯折会简化。侧栏和 favicon 使用透明猫咪，大图可使用灰紫色底纹展示。
